result.task: Add a developer-only debug overlay and a static frame inspector to the talking-face app, so lip-sync problems can be attributed to the right layer.
result.summary:
Implemented the developer-only lip-sync diagnostics.

- Added live overlay with articulation bars, targets, pose weights, timing, visual lead, and color-coded timeline.
- Added grid, instant flip, and REST pixel-difference inspector views.
- Gated behind DEV mode plus `?debug=1`, persisted in localStorage. Use `?debug=0` to disable.
- Integrated minimally into the talk screen without changing playback behavior.
